en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European town taken from an elevated grassy slope with garden plots in the foreground. The middle ground is filled with tightly packed two‑ to three‑story houses with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows, typical of Central Europe. In the distant background rise several large church buildings with tall, narrow spires and neo‑Gothic details, along with a few more massive institutional buildings and smokestacks from early industry. Trees line many of the streets, and two people stand on the hillside at the right edge of the image.
